quarterly_data.quarter: Merck & Co. press release: Merck's Tulisokibart Met Primary and Key Secondary (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Phase 2b MK-7240-012 results for tulisokibart (anti-TL1A) in moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa, presented at EADV 2026: HiSCR50 at week 16 was achieved by 72% of the high-dose group (480 mg Q2W) and 64% of the medium-dose group (480 mg Q4W) versus 35% on placebo, meeting the primary endpoint; HiSCR75 was 41% and 40% versus 15%; adverse events occurred in 42.9%, 47.6% and 52.4% of the high-, medium- and low-dose groups versus 40.9% on placebo, with no serious or opportunistic infections. Merck plans to advance tulisokibart to Phase 3 in HS; it is in development in six indications, including Phase 3 ATLAS-UC and ARES-CD.
